requirements.text: Shoppers add, change and remove line items, and quantities are validated
Prices, totals, tax, shipping and inventory come from the server, never from client-supplied values
A cart is bound to its session or customer; others cannot read or modify it
Totals use integer minor units in one currency per cart
Checkout cannot oversell stock under concurrent orders
Placing the order completes at most once; an uncertain payment outcome is reconciled rather than blindly retried
The order is marked paid only after a provider confirmation verified by signature over the raw body

evidence.name: storefront and utility sources compile strictly and behave
storefront and utility sources compile strictly and behave
cart mutation routes use item identifiers
lost or malformed mutation responses remain uncertain
Medusa core adapter sends regional pricing query
uncertain provider outcome blocks order completion and another attempt

implementations.notes: Medusa Store API adapter and checkout controller against a fake fetch and fixture cart; no live Medusa backend or payment provider was run. Add, change and remove send only identifiers and quantities, and totals/prices/availability are read from the backend response. At-most-once completion and uncertain-outcome blocking are enforced per checkout controller instance; cross-process completion and reconciling the uncertain outcome are the backend's and application's work

The adapter calls the application's authorize callback before credentials or network access (pack test: cart authorization runs before credential access), but binding a cart to its session or customer is the callback's work and is not tested

evidence.name: Stripe-Signature: multiple v1, tolerance in both directions

implementations.notes: Verifies the provider signature; marking the order paid is the application's work
